verdict.rationale: SerpApi has no native natural-language interface of its own. It does document a first-party MCP integration that lets MCP-compatible agents (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) use SerpApi as a search tool, and the official serpapi-mcp server is confirmed. This lets users drive searches through natural-language prompts, but the language interpretation is done by the external agent. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface within SerpApi itself, documentation of which operations (beyond web search) can be driven conversationally, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP workflow.
